# Assessment Overview

Supplementary documents generated for this assessment.
- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — Diagrams the application layers, storage integration, and component relationships.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — Maps the 34 declared NuGet dependencies by category and summarizes compatibility concerns.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — Catalogs MVC actions, service communication, and the primary request flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — Documents blob storage ownership, persistence operations, and data classification.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Inventories runtime/build configuration, settings, and secret provisioning.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Describes the gallery, upload, and deletion workflows and business rules.
